findings.failure_path: Both supposedly impossible control anchors are literal text in this newly tracked script. `git grep -F` over the frozen HEAD therefore finds each anchor in this file, `bad` becomes non-empty, and the probe exits 1; the checked-in output claiming the control returned zero could only have been produced before the file was tracked or from a different candidate.
findings.smallest_fix: Construct control strings at runtime from noncontiguous fragments or exclude this evidence file from the grep scope, then regenerate and check in output from the frozen candidate.

findings.failure_path: The `delete` decision relies on zero-hit impossibility and bypasses in `d1_widened_scan.sh`, but the supplied v3 contract already rejects zero-hit adjudication and instead has an independent reviewer classify complete grep/log/test material. An active rule whose ledger locator is self-referential can consequently be moved to `firing 主张不成立` even though v3 would find real post-landing triggering; the plan has changed the proposition rather than reproduced a defect in it.
findings.smallest_fix: Exercise v3's actual three-part evidence and independent-adjudication path with controlled positive, negative, and insufficient cases. If only free-text terminalization is defective, add a controlled structured verdict instead of deleting the behavioral terminal.

findings.failure_path: The plan says withdrawing the claim merely triggers another four-leg run and that re-base versus retirement is decided afterward. The supplied claim-liveness rule requires every dependent mechanism to be re-based or retired in the same landing; otherwise sequence 5 can withdraw support while a stale gate continues charging or blocking later changes on that dead claim.
findings.smallest_fix: Make sequence 5 atomic with enumeration of dependent mechanisms, same-landing re-base or retirement, and the obligation-preservation walk; if that cannot be completed, keep enforcement active and require a named risk owner, recorded cost, and bounded end event for the pending disposition.
